notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
description:
Activate Ilysian Caryatid by tapping it, adding two mana of any color
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Ilysian Caryatid.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Ilysian Caryatid.
Repeat.
